purpose: Machine-readable source material for HTML/CSS-to-Astylar translation and the checked astylarui-developer skill.

classifications.direct: Ordinary web knowledge transfers without meaningful qualification.
classifications.compatible: The observable result is equivalent within the stated Astylar constraints.
classifications.different: The concept exists but its syntax, lifecycle, rendering, or semantics differ.
classifications.unsupported: The current public document and renderer cannot express the capability.
classifications.plugin: A trusted Angular plugin can contribute the capability through the public plugin contract.

queryRules.elements: Find the name in elements.groups. A name absent there is not a built-in element; consult unsupported.elements and pluginExtensionPoints.
queryRules.domFields: Find the field in domFields.groups. SiteData is JSON-like data, not a live browser Node tree.
queryRules.styleProperties: Find the camelCase field in styleProperties.groups. Author stylesheet rules in SiteData.styles and inline declarations in DOMElement.style.
queryRules.defaults: Global and element defaults are authoritative in src/app/config/browser-defaults.ts; fingerprints below force review whenever they change.
queryRules.proof: Evidence entries name a parity fixture or a committed executable/source file. Absence of focused evidence must not be upgraded into a support claim.

elements.identitySyntax: Built-ins accept their HTML tag alias. Plugins use canonical namespace:name IDs and may expose a conflict-free alias.

groups.behavior: JSON children preserve authored order; semantic roles are bridged where the supported accessibility contract defines them.
Ordered and unordered markers and browser-like block flow are supported; marker styling is not a complete CSS list module.
The tested auto/fixed table subset, spans, column widths, captions, and semantic structure are supported.
Anchors expose host-owned navigation outcomes; images load through owned asynchronous resources with intrinsic sizing and object-fit support.

A deliberate control, focus, keyboard, pointer, validation, submit/reset, selection, and closed/expanded select subset is supported. Text selection uses full-line highlight geometry and a contrast-selected foreground glyph pass. The default text-control caret follows the resolved text color; authored caret-color is not yet supported.
groups.defaultStyle: elementDefaults[name] merged over globalDefaultStyle; checkbox/radio use inputType-specific defaults

groups.behavior: Text content, measured wrapping, common inherited typography, inline/inline-block flow, pointer selection, contrast-selected foreground glyph paint, native copy of direct non-control text, and the recorded defaults are supported within canvas-text constraints.
open plus modal opts into the tested top-layer, inertness, focus containment, Escape cancel, and close lifecycle subset; backdrop paint is authored explicitly.

These identities and defaults are registered, but native embedded browsing, media playback, canvas drawing, disclosure widgets, maps, and complete option-group behavior are not implemented. Treat them as generic or hidden layout nodes, not browser feature parity.
groups.recommendedAlternative: Use ordinary supported structure or a namespaced Angular plugin with an owned Babylon renderer.

groups.behavior: Plain serializable authored identity and tree data; class is a whitespace-separated string and style is the camelCase inline declaration object.
Fields are supported only to the extent documented by the element, semantic, form, image, table, and interaction evidence; their presence does not imply every browser algorithm.
Astylar-specific boolean paired with dialog.open to request the supported modal/top-layer subset.
CamelCase JSON fields feed Astylar's offscreen semantic bridge, not DOM attributes on the Babylon canvas.
JSON-oriented Astylar data replaces parts of browser DOM object state. inputElement is runtime compatibility state and should not be used as authored portable data.
Executable strings are never evaluated.
Unknown-safe serializable payload owned and validated by the resolved element plugin.

styleProperties.authoringSyntax: camelCase StyleRule keys; selectors remain CSS-like strings; plugin declarations live in extensions under canonical namespace:name keys.

groups.values: selector string plus px/em/rem/vw/vh media bounds
groups.behavior: Media queries are expressed as bounds on each JSON rule rather than an @media grammar.

groups.values: position: static|relative|absolute|fixed; offsets: auto or supported length; zIndex: integer|auto
groups.behavior: Tested containing-block and stacking subset; no sticky positioning.

groups.values: auto, supported lengths and percentages; boxSizing content-box|border-box
groups.default: width/height:auto; min constraints:0/auto; max constraints:none; boxSizing:content-box

groups.values: one to four supported lengths; margins additionally accept auto in supported layout paths
documented color/gradient, solid-border, radius, shadow and numeric-opacity subsets
groups.default: transparent background/border, no shadow, radius 0, opacity 1
groups.behavior: Paint is Babylon material/texture output; it is not a complete browser compositing engine.
Astylar/Babylon mesh-shape selection; not a CSS property.
Participates in Astylar positioning/stacking and Babylon output; browser transform grammar and 3D compositing are not complete.
Prefer DOMElement href/target and typed events. onclick strings are not executed.

groups.values: implemented CSS-like typography keywords, colors, font strings, unitless/length values, and whitespace/wrapping subsets
groups.default: browser-like text defaults; element defaults may override
groups.behavior: Measured through canvas text; installed fonts and browser canvas metrics affect fidelity.

groups.values: implemented keyword and compact string subsets; textOverflow clip|ellipsis

groups.behavior: Owned clip regions and tested wheel/scroll-into-view behavior; not the complete browser scrolling API.

groups.default: block globally, overridden by element defaults

groups.values: tested Flexbox keyword, numeric, shorthand and supported-length subset
groups.default: row/nowrap/flex-start/stretch; grow 0, shrink 1, basis auto, order 0

groups.values: explicit/implicit tracks using px, %, fr, auto, min-content, max-content, repeat() and supported minmax() forms; numeric line placement subset
unknown-safe values validated by the owning plugin property contribution
groups.behavior: Canonical namespace:name identities participate in cascade, validation, defaults and invalidation domains.

selectors.cascade: Element defaults, stylesheet specificity/source order, renderer context overrides, then inline style; extensions cascade by canonical identity.
selectors.differences: This is a measured selector subset, not querySelector or a complete Selectors Level 4 engine.

platform.astylarPattern: Serializable SiteData.root.children DOMElement tree plus SiteData.styles.
Angular EnvironmentProviders and AstylarSurfaceComponent or Astylar.mount(); each mounted surface owns an EnvironmentInjector and Babylon scene lifetime.
Layout is authored in CSS-like pixels, projected through pixel-to-world scale into Babylon meshes/materials, camera and scene ownership.

platform.webConcept: Application-driven DOM updates retaining compatible state
platform.astylarPattern: AstylarSurface.update() reconciles authored identity and preserves compatible semantic/control/scroll state under the documented rules.
An offscreen semantic bridge mirrors the supported structure/state while Babylon remains the visual surface.

platform.webConcept: Custom elements/properties or non-browser visual behavior
platform.astylarPattern: Trusted Angular providers contribute namespaced schema, renderer, lifecycle, migration and invalidation contracts with explicit Babylon resource ownership.

elements.recommendedAlternative: Use host Angular code for behavior, SiteData.styles for declarations, supported structure/images, or a trusted namespaced plugin when custom Babylon output is appropriate.

css.recommendedAlternative: Author deterministic supported layout/paint values, drive state through Angular and AstylarSurface.update(), or use a plugin-owned Babylon capability with explicit lifecycle ownership.
css.pluginCanSupply: Some visual/runtime concepts can be supplied by plugins, but plugins do not extend the core CSS parser itself.

freshness.policy: The check compares exact public element, DOMElement and StyleRule names and verifies normalized SHA-256 fingerprints for semantic implementation sources. A public capability change must update and re-review this catalog.
